Nano Banana 2 is an image generation model. Display name is not the API id.

## gemini-3.1-flash-image

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Model code | `gemini-3.1-flash-image` |
| Supported data types | **Inputs** Text, Image **Output** Images |
| Token limits | **Input token limit** 32,768 **Output token limit** 8,192 |
| Capabilities | **[Function calling](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/function-calling)** Not supported **[Structured outputs](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/structured-output)** Not supported |
